title: CLI: `os explain object` shows the object colour in its object table
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Follow-up from #35985 (object colour), nit N7 of the schema-face L2 record 7059551938 on PR 1 #36012. It was taken off #35985's last PR (#36089), so that PR stays on the low-risk skills arm. Under epic #34571.

## What a developer sees

`os explain object <name>` prints the object's properties in a table (`packages/cli/src/commands/explain.ts`). Objects now have a `color` (one of `gray · blue · teal · green · amber · orange · red · pink · purple`), but the table does not show it.

## To do

Add one `color` row to the object table, printing the colour name, or the default (gray) when none is set. Add a test, and a `@objectstack/cli` patch changeset. The measured patch is on #36089's history (head `545f84cc`) if it helps.

## Acceptance

- `os explain object` on an object with a colour shows that colour, and on one without a colour shows the default, pinned.
